title: Abilities tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Abilities domain: the statuses abilities apply and each ability's numbers, keyed by content ID and grouped by archetype (ADR-008 §3). VeyraAbilities binds it to FVeyraAbilitiesTuning. A list whose name ends "ByRank" holds one value for every rank, or one value per rank.

statBlock.description: Base stats or their growth (FVeyraStatBlock), each at least 0.

basicAttack.description: How a unit's basic attacks work (Combat Bible §4, §48; ADR-008 §2).

range.description: Edge to edge, in units (Combat Bible §40).

windupFraction.description: The part of each attack's interval before Commit.

projectile.description: A ranged attack's homing projectile; empty for melee.

byRank.description: One value for every rank, or one value per rank (5 for a basic ability, 3 for an ultimate).

cast.description: How a cast is timed and paid for (Combat Bible §26, §27, §48; ADR-008 §4).

cooldownSecondsByRank.description: Cooldown in seconds, starting at Commit.

castRange.description: How far from the caster the cast's ground point may be, in units; a point beyond it is brought back within it (ADR-008 §9). 0 for an ability that needs no point.

windupSeconds.description: Seconds before Commit. An interruption during them costs nothing and starts part of the cooldown (Combat Bible §26).

windupMovement.description: Whether the caster may move during the windup (Combat Bible §48).

recoverySeconds.description: Seconds after delivery before the caster may cast again.

recastWindow.description: At most one: the follow-up its slot holds once this cast commits, for a while (ADR-018 §1). Empty for none.

targetMustHold.description: At most one status ID: the cast takes only a target that holds it from the caster, as Tavi's second Tag! takes only It (ADR-030 §7).

targetMustNotHold.description: At most one status ID: the cast refuses a target that holds it from the caster, as Passing Step's lockout keeps it off a unit it just passed through (ADR-031 §8).

takedownRefund.description: At most one fraction: the share of its remaining cooldown a takedown its caster takes part in refunds; 1 resets it, as Black Step's (ADR-031 §9).

currentResourceFraction.description: At most one: the share of the caster's current resource it also costs, above 0 and at most 1, paid at Commit with the cost by rank (Combat Bible §27; ADR-033 §3).

minimumResource.description: At most one: the resource, above 0, the caster must hold to cast it at all (ADR-033 §3).

needsCompanion.description: Living: refused, as NoCompanion, while its caster has no living companion (ADR-034 §8).

cooldownOf.description: At most one: another ability with a cast whose cooldown this one shares, held under that ability's ID; that one shares none itself (ADR-035 §1).

refusedWhile.description: Status IDs whose holding refuses the cast, as HeldBack (ADR-035 §2).

cooldownWhile.description: Each status its caster holds from itself as it starts its cooldown scales the cooldown by its multiplier (ADR-034 §8).

recastWindow.description: A recast window: the slot holds another ability until it is cast or its time runs out (ADR-018 §1).

onExpiry.description: Lapse loses the follow-up; Cast casts it where the caster faces.

opensWhen.description: Always: as every cast commits. TargetHeld: only if the cast's target already held heldStatus from the caster. TargetFalls: only if the target dies, credited to the caster, within fallsWithinSeconds (ADR-030 §7).

heldStatus.description: TargetHeld: one status ID. Empty otherwise.

armingSeconds.description: Always: how long after the cast commits the follow-up opens, as a wall cools before it can be detonated (ADR-032 §5); 0 for at once, and always 0 otherwise.

damage.description: One damage component: its amount at the caster's rank plus the caster's power times the ratios, fixed at Commit (Combat Bible §25, §50).

displacement.description: A Knockback or Pull of each unit hit (Combat Bible §9). Displacement Resistance shortens it.

direction.description: TowardOrigin pulls toward the area's origin or the caster; AwayFromOrigin knocks back from it; AcrossCastLeft and AcrossCastRight push sideways to the cast; AsideFromPath pushes out of a projectile's path.

distance.description: Units; a Pull toward the origin stops there.

collisionStatuses.description: Given a unit whose displacement collides with terrain, a Vanguard or a structure, where it stops (ADR-028 §3).

effects.description: What happens to each unit hit.

missingHealthDamage.description: At most one, beside damage: damage for the Health the target already lacks, read when the hit lands and joining its component of that type (Combat Bible §50).

unitKindMultipliers.description: Damage multiplied against some kinds of unit, at least 1, once per kind, never structures (ADR-018 §6).

displacementUnlessStatuses.description: Statuses that spare a unit this displacement: one displacement per target per cast (Roster Bible §1).

reactions.description: What the hit adds when its target holds a status, read as the hit lands (ADR-026 §1): Rupture's burst on Splinters, Flash Cure's stun on an Unstable target.

status.description: The status the target must hold, from any source.

consume.description: Consume removes the status once the reaction resolves.

scaling.description: Once, or PerStack: times the stacks the target held.

replaces.description: Statuses of the bundle's own this reaction takes the place of.

burst.description: At most one: a burst around the target as it reacts, for the caster's other enemies in its shape (ADR-034 §6).

damage.description: One component per damage type at most.

zone.description: One zone of an area: its shape and what it does to each enemy in it.

casterShieldPerVanguard.description: At most one: a shield the caster gains once for each enemy Vanguard the zone catches, such as an ultimate's per-target shield.

casterStatusesPerVanguard.description: Statuses the caster gains for each enemy Vanguard the zone catches, such as the state an ultimate enters when it lands on a Vanguard (No Quarter; ADR-008 §9).

allyEffects.description: At most one: what it does for its caster's allied Vanguards in its shape, each once: its caster's heal by rank plus Magic Power, and statuses (ADR-035 §4).
What a zone or a ride's contact does for its caster's allied Vanguards, each once: its caster's heal by rank plus Magic Power, and statuses (ADR-035 §4).

healByRank.description: Health each ally regains, by rank, before Magic Power; 0 with no ratio for no heal.

healMagicPowerRatio.description: Added to the heal for each point of the caster's Magic Power at Commit.

reach.description: OthersOnly: allied Vanguards, the caster apart. CasterToo: the caster among them.

shield.description: A shield granted to the caster (Combat Bible §7, §51; ADR-009 §3): the rank's amount plus the caster's Max Health and Magic Power times the ratios.

id.description: The shield's identity: a new grant meets an active shield with it from the same caster as reapply says.

maxHealthRatio.description: Of the caster's Max Health, added to the amount.

reapply.description: Replace: a new grant starts the shield again. Merge: it adds to what is left, up to the maximum, and restarts the duration.

maxAmountMaxHealthRatio.description: The most a merged shield holds, as a fraction of the caster's Max Health; never less than one grant.

capGroup.description: At most one: a group whose shields from this caster together hold at most a share of its Max Health, such as Cairn's passive and ultimate shields.

absorbedReward.description: At most one: once a grant of this shield has absorbed this fraction of its amount, its holder gains the statuses once, from its provider (ADR-027 §5).

shape.description: A hit shape (ADR-009 §4). Each kind uses its own sizes; the others are 0.

arcDegrees.description: Sector: the whole angle, in degrees.

length.description: Rectangle: along the cast's direction, in units.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

interruptedCooldownFraction.description: The part of its cooldown a cast starts when it is interrupted before Commit (Combat Bible §26).

statuses.description: Statuses abilities apply, keyed by their stable ID (Combat Bible §8, §46).

magnitude.description: Read as the kind says (EVeyraStatusKind): 0 for a Stun, the fraction of speed removed for a Slow, a signed change for Move Speed and Attack Speed, one tick's damage at its source's first Level for DamageOverTime, the fraction removed for the others.

durationSeconds.description: Before Tenacity, which shortens crowd control only.

takedownExtensionSeconds.description: Seconds each takedown adds; 0 for none.

takedownExtensionMaxSeconds.description: The most takedowns add in all.

damageOverTime.description: How a DamageOverTime status ticks (Combat Bible §14): one entry for that kind, none for any other.

tickSeconds.description: Seconds between ticks; the first comes this long after it lands.

damagePerLevel.description: Added to each tick for each Level of its source's beyond the first, fixed as it lands.

stackDecaySeconds.description: For a stacking status: once its duration runs out it loses one stack and lasts this long again, until the last stack goes (ADR-018 §2). 0 to end at once.

arcDegrees.description: DirectionalDamageReduction and Cover: the arc of the unit's facing it guards, in degrees; 0 for any other kind.

atMaxStacks.description: At most one: the status this becomes when an application brings it to its most stacks, from the same source (ADR-026 §2).

unitKinds.description: AttackDamageAmplification: the unit kinds it amplifies attacks against; Cover: the kinds of ally it shelters (EVeyraUnitKind). Empty for all, and for any other kind.

landsOn.description: The kinds of unit it lands on (EVeyraUnitKind), empty for every kind, as Splinters embed only in Vanguards (ADR-026 §2).

attackCharges.description: How many of its holder's basic attacks it lasts, each that commits spending one (ADR-033 §4); 0 for a status attacks do not spend.

cover.description: Cover (ADR-037 §4): one entry for that kind, none for any other. Its holder shelters the allies behind it, within its reach, from projectiles whose source lies within its arc, preventing its magnitude's share of their damage before mitigation out of its capacity, which refills each time it is given; its holder takes transferShare of what it prevents.

reach.description: How far behind its holder it shelters.

capacity.description: What it prevents in all, before mitigation, each time it is given.

transferShare.description: The share of what it prevents that its holder takes, as a proc from the projectile's source.

targetedDamage.description: Abilities cast at one enemy that resolve at once and deal one damage component and may put statuses on it (Combat Bible §29 targeted, instant; ADR-015 §3). test_bolt is the developer test ability (ADR-006 M3); its values are provisional.

castRange.description: Cast range in units, measured edge to edge (Combat Bible §40).

cooldownSeconds.description: Cooldown in seconds, starting at Commit (Combat Bible §26).

damageAmount.description: Raw damage before any modifier (Combat Bible §25, step 2), at the caster's first Level; 0 for an ability that only applies statuses.

damagePerLevel.description: Added for each Level of the caster's beyond the first, read at Commit.

statuses.description: Put on the target it hits.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of unit it may target (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any hostile unit. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

area.description: Abilities that hit the enemies in shapes at the caster or a ground point, at once, after a delay, or in channel ticks (ADR-008 §3).

origin.description: Caster: on the caster, facing the cast's point. TargetPoint: on the point, facing away from the caster. CastersLingeringArea: on the caster's own lingering area of originAbility, which ends (ADR-028 §5). CastersMarker: on the caster's own standing marker or wall of originAbility, facing as it does, which ends (ADR-032 §6).

originAbility.description: For the CastersLingeringArea origin, exactly one: the area ability whose lingering area it lands on. For CastersMarker, exactly one: the ability whose marker or wall it lands on. Else none.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds between Commit and the hit, with the area telegraphed; the caster is free meanwhile.

channelTicks.description: How many times the area hits over channelSeconds, the caster held in place.

reveal.description: Ordinary vision the area lights for its caster's side as it commits, which over Dense Fog reports presence instead (ADR-016 §5), as Sounding Flare's; 0 and 0 for none.

fog.description: At most one: Dense Fog the area lays as it commits, the same construct as the map's (ADR-036 §3), as Lay the Mist's. A Circle has a radius and no length or width; a Corridor runs from where the area lands along the cast's direction, a length and a width and no radius.

zones.description: Innermost first: a unit takes the first zone that touches it, and no other.

linger.description: At most one: after it hits at once, the area lasts in its outermost zone's shape, giving those inside it statuses by side (ADR-018 §5), as Kade's Sightline does.

pulseSeconds.description: Seconds between the statuses it gives; it gives them first as it lands.

allyStatuses.description: For the allied Vanguards inside, its caster apart.

sight.description: Ordinary: its shape is ordinary vision for its caster's side while it lasts, never True Sight and nothing in Dense Fog.

pulseEffects.description: At most one: what each pulse after it lands does to the enemy units inside, reactions included (ADR-026 §4). Its zones are what it does as it lands.

endEffects.description: At most one: what it does to the enemy units inside as it ends, measured from its centre, so a displacement toward the origin draws them in (ADR-026 §4).

endWarningSeconds.description: How long before its end the presentation marks it: above 0 exactly when it has endEffects, and no longer than it lasts.

movementField.description: At most one: a field it holds while it stands, bending its caster's enemies' dashes and displacements toward its centre by up to pull units; its area's outermost zone is then a circle (ADR-033 §5).

shieldTopUp.description: At most one: a shield it builds on its caster and the allied Vanguards inside, granted again at each pulse and merging up to its maximum, but not for one damaged within delayAfterDamageSeconds (ADR-036 §4), as Waymark's.

consumesCasterStatuses.description: Statuses the caster loses as it commits, whatever their stacks, as Break the Line spends Cadence (ADR-018 §6).

channelMovement.description: Locked holds the caster in place while it channels; Free lets it move, each tick placed where it stands (ADR-018 §6).

casterStatuses.description: Put on the caster as it commits.

healOnHit.description: At most one: Health the caster restores from the units it hits, capped for the cast (ADR-018 §6).

delayWithin.description: For a delayed area: the first entry whose lingering area, its caster's own of the named ability, holds the area's point sets its delay instead (ADR-026 §4), as Flash Cure's inside CODE BLACK.

selfBuff.description: Abilities that buff their caster, and optionally nearby allied Vanguards (ADR-008 §3).

shields.description: At most one shield on the caster (Combat Bible §7).

aura.description: At most one aura of statuses for nearby allied Vanguards (ADR-008 §9).

radius.description: Units from the caster's centre to an ally's edge.

refreshSeconds.description: How often allies in range get the statuses again; the statuses should outlast it.

enemyStatuses.description: Put on each living enemy unit in range at every refresh, never a structure or a ward (ADR-018 §6).

allyFluxbornStatuses.description: Put on each allied Fluxborn in range at every refresh, as Full Grid overclocks them (ADR-033 §6).

heal.description: At most one heal for the caster and its most wounded allied Vanguard in range (ADR-015 §3), never above Max Health.

amount.description: Health restored at the caster's first Level.

amountPerLevel.description: Added for each Level of the caster's beyond the first.

allyRange.description: Units from the caster's centre to an ally's edge; 0 heals the caster alone.

statuses.description: Put on each unit it heals.

recast.description: EndsEarly: casting again while the buff lasts ends it, at no cost.

variants.description: Slots that hold another ability for a while as the buff lands (ADR-018 §1), as Dig In's volley form during The Last Volley. A variant takes its slot's rank.

slot.description: Q, W, E or R: a basic ability's slot or the ultimate's.

cooldown.description: Own keeps its own cooldown; Shared is one cooldown with the slot's own ability.

temporaryHealth.description: At most one: Temporary Health for its caster (Combat Bible §7; ADR-018 §6).

maxHealthRatio.description: And this share of the caster's Max Health.

endPayload.description: At most one: as the buff ends, a status on each enemy unit near its caster, lasting longer for each hit the caster took meanwhile (ADR-018 §6).

afterSeconds.description: When it comes, in seconds after the cast.

radius.description: Units from the caster's centre to an enemy's edge.

status.description: A status ID from the statuses map.

minHits.description: The hits the caster must take for it to come at all; 0 for always.

displacement.description: At most one, AwayFromOrigin: each enemy it reaches is pushed away from the holder too (ADR-028 §6).

recipient.description: Who takes the buff: its caster, or an allied Vanguard the cast names within its range, else its caster (ADR-027 §4).

recipientZones.description: Innermost first: zones that land once on the recipient as it takes the buff, facing away from the caster, and hit the enemies there (ADR-027 §8).

marker.description: At most one: a placed marker the buff leaves where its caster stood (ADR-030 §5), as Tavi's illusion. Casting the buff again while it stands recalls it; recalled or destroyed, it bursts with its burst zones around it.

hitsToDestroy.description: The hits that destroy it; 0 for one no one can target.

look.description: Plain: as what it is. AsOwner: as its owner to its owner's enemies, a decoy.

shieldHolds.description: Status IDs the recipient holds while the buff's shield holds, lasting no longer than the shield, removed as it breaks or runs out (ADR-032 §3). They need a shield.

drain.description: At most one: what the buff drains of its caster's resource while it lasts: perSecond, taken every intervalSeconds, for at most maxSeconds; it ends early as the resource runs out (ADR-033 §6). Only on the caster's own buff.

shieldEndZones.description: Innermost first: zones that land around the recipient as the buff's shield breaks or runs out, the caster's (ADR-032 §3). They need a shield.

companionStatuses.description: Statuses its caster's companion holds while the buff lasts, as Nix's true form (ADR-034 §7).

companionDeath.description: Ends: the buff ends as its caster's companion is banished (ADR-034 §7).

chain.description: At most one: a chain between its caster and its companion while it lasts; enemies on the line take its effects at each pulse, each no more often than perEnemySeconds (ADR-034 §7).

attackSecondaryImpact.description: At most one: for a while after the cast, its recipient's basic attacks offer this secondary impact, as a piercing shot (ADR-027 §3).

seconds.description: How long its attacks offer it.

skillshot.description: Abilities that fire a line projectile toward the cast's point; terrain stops it (ADR-008 §3, §9).

radius.description: The projectile's own radius: it hits a unit whose body it touches.

range.description: How far it flies before it ends, in units.

collision.description: FirstEnemy: the first enemy unit stops it. FirstEnemyVanguard: only an enemy Vanguard stops it; it passes through other enemies. Pierce: nothing stops it but terrain and its range.

passThroughEffects.description: On each unit a FirstEnemyVanguard projectile passes through; empty lists otherwise.

mimic.description: At most one: while its caster's marker from markerAbility stands, the marker throws the same shot from where it stands toward the same point. The two share what they strike: a unit both strike takes repeatEffects from the second instead of the full effects (ADR-031 §6).

endWall.description: At most one: where the projectile's flight ends, at its range, terrain or a unit it stops at, it leaves a wall across its path: a marker of its caster's, of this ability's ID, that blocks units of both teams, dashes and line projectiles as terrain does, and that paths go round, for lifetimeSeconds. One stands at a time (ADR-032 §4).

returnIfHeld.description: At most one: striking a unit that already held status from its caster, the shot flies back to the caster at speed; reaching them refunds cooldownRefund of the ability's remaining cooldown (ADR-030 §8).

casterDash.description: At most one: the caster recoils away from the aim as the shot leaves (ADR-018 §6), as Kade's Reposition does.

dash.description: Abilities that move their caster, with effects as it sets off and where it stops (ADR-008 §3; Combat Bible §9). Displacement interrupts a dash; terrain stops it.

direction.description: TowardPoint: toward the cast's point. AwayFromPoint: straight back from it, as a recoil. AwayFromHost: straight back from the unit the caster holds on to, letting go (ADR-018 §2). ThroughTarget: through the enemy unit the cast names, to distance beyond it, the unit taking the contact effects (ADR-030 §6).

distance.description: Units; terrain stops the dash sooner.

contact.description: StopAtFirstEnemy: the dash ends at the first enemy it meets, which takes the contact effects.

startZones.description: Areas at the caster, facing the cast's point, as the dash sets off; innermost first.

contactEffects.description: On the enemy a StopAtFirstEnemy dash stops at.

contactSelfStatuses.description: Put on the caster when it stops at an enemy.

hostEffects.description: On the unit an AwayFromHost dash lets go of, as the throw's stumble; no effects for any other dash.

endZones.description: Areas at the caster, facing the cast's point, as the dash sets off; innermost first.

rideExit.description: Stay: it rides on, if it rides. Leave: it separates rider and vehicle first, as Bail Out and Last Exit do (Combat Bible §56).

duringDash.description: Cast during one of its caster's own dashes: Refused until that dash ends, or TakesOver, ending it where the caster is and dashing from there (ADR-031 §7).

targetKinds.description: ThroughTarget: the kinds of unit it may pass through (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any enemy unit, and empty for any other dash. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

empoweredAttack.description: Abilities that empower the caster's next basic attack, which stays a basic attack (ADR-008 §3; Combat Bible §17).

durationSeconds.description: How long the empowerment waits for an attack.

attacks.description: How many basic attacks it empowers; each spends one (ADR-027 §2).

windupScale.description: What the empowered attacks' windups are multiplied by; their interval is unchanged.

damage.description: Joins the attack's own damage event, so the empowered attack is still one hit.

armorPenetrationByRank.description: The fraction of the target's Armor the attack ignores, at most 1: percentage penetration (Combat Bible §3).

cleave.description: At most one: the other enemies in the attacker's cleave shape take part of the attack's damage.

secondaryImpact.description: At most one: proc damage in a shape behind the target, excluding it. The attack keeps the highest-priority impact offered, such as over a passive's (ADR-009 §5).

volley.description: Abilities that open a lane their caster fires into shot by shot (ADR-018 §6), as Kade's Kill Corridor: the slot holds the shot for a while, and each shot keeps within the lane.

shot.description: Each shot: a skillshot, whose cooldown is the time between shots.

laneHalfAngleDegrees.description: How far either side of the lane a shot may aim.

casterStatuses.description: For the caster while the lane lasts, as a stance that plants it.

bonus.description: At most one: an ally displacing an enemy that carries status from the caster earns a shot, up to maxShots.

tether.description: Abilities that tether an enemy to their caster (Combat Bible §43; ADR-018), as Patch's Don't Leave Me: the caster's side sees the target while it holds; stretched beyond its range, it may snap the target back once, and ends.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of unit it may target (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any hostile unit. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

maxRange.description: Edge to edge, in units; beyond it the tether stretches. At least the cast's range.

snapDistance.description: Stretched, the pull toward the caster, in units before Displacement Resistance; 0 for none.

snapSpeed.description: The pull's units per second: above 0 with a pull, 0 without.

targetStatuses.description: Held on the target while the tether lasts.

attach.description: Abilities that leap their caster at an enemy and hold on to it (ADR-018 §2), as Patch's Bear Hug: ending within reach, the caster attaches for a while and the host takes the host effects and holds the host statuses; out of reach, nothing more happens.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of unit it may target (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any hostile unit. Never Structure (Combat Bible §33).

reachOnArrival.description: Edge to edge, in units, how near the target must be as the leap ends for the caster to take hold.

hostStatuses.description: Held on the host while the caster holds on.

hostEffects.description: On the host as the caster takes hold.

ride.description: Abilities that put their caster in a ride state (Combat Bible §56; ADR-018 §7), as Raska's Kickstart and NO BRAKES: a set speed and a limited turn rate, mounted actions in their slots, statuses held meanwhile, and a vehicle that goes on without its rider as the ride ends.

setSpeed.description: The rider's Movement Speed, set rather than added.

decaySeconds.description: Seconds over which the rider slows back to its ordinary speed after.

riderStatuses.description: Held on the rider while it rides.

mounted.description: The mounted actions, one per basic ability's slot.

vehicle.description: At most one: the skillshot its vehicle goes on as along the rider's heading as the ride ends.

crashZones.description: Innermost first: zones that erupt where the rider is as the ride ends, on every end but death, as the rider's hit (ADR-035 §3).

contact.description: At most one: what its rider's body does to the units it meets, each once a ride (ADR-035 §6).

reach.description: How far past the rider's edge it meets a unit's edge.

pulseSeconds.description: Seconds between its looks for what it meets.

enemyEffects.description: On each enemy it meets, as its rider's hit; a knock aside is AsideFromPath, off the ride's line.

enemyKinds.description: The kinds of enemy unit it strikes; any when empty.

allyEffects.description: At most one: what it does for each allied Vanguard it meets.

trail.description: At most one: an area ability laid along its path every spacing units, the first as it sets off, at its rider as its rider's hit (ADR-035 §6).

pulseSeconds.description: Seconds between its looks at how far its rider has come; at its set speed a pulse covers no more than its spacing.

area.description: An area ability that lands at once and lingers.

ambush.description: Abilities that vanish and strike (ADR-030 §9), as Tavi's Ready or Not!: cast on an enemy Vanguard the caster damaged, crowd-controlled or debuffed within recentSeconds, the caster holds its vanish statuses for vanishSeconds, then blinks besideDistance from its target, if it still lives, and lands its effects.

vanishStatuses.description: Status IDs on the caster while it is gone, ended as it strikes.

besideDistance.description: How far from its target's edge it reappears.

effects.description: On the target as it strikes.

stance.description: Abilities that swap their caster's own abilities in some slots for another set, and back (ADR-031 §3), as Angeru's Forsake the Schools: each set keeps its own cooldowns, each slot its rank, and a follow-up of a stowed ability waits for it.

slots.description: Q, W, E or R, each once and never the slot the stance itself sits in (ADR-035 §1), with the ability it holds while the stance lasts. Each takes its slot's rank.

placement.description: Abilities that place one of their caster's markers at a point within their cast range, on the nearest navigable ground, in place of any placed before (ADR-031 §4), as Angeru's False Body. A follow-up the cast opens ends with the marker.

hitsToDestroy.description: The hits that destroy it; 0 for one no one can target.

look.description: Plain: as what it is. AsOwner: as its owner to its owner's enemies, a decoy.

burstZones.description: Empty: a placed marker bursts with nothing.

blink.description: Abilities that move their caster at once (ADR-031 §5), as Angeru's Black Step and False Body's swap: beside an enemy unit, which takes the effects, or to the caster's standing marker from markerAbility, which with a swap takes the caster's old place. A cast range of 0 lets a blink to its own marker reach it anywhere.

to.description: EnemyUnit, OwnMarker, or EnemyUnitOrOwnMarker as the cast names one; OwnCompanion for its caster's companion (ADR-034 §5).

markerAbility.description: At most one: the ability whose marker it may go to.

targetKinds.description: The kinds of enemy unit it may name (EVeyraUnitKind); empty for any.

besideDistance.description: How far from an enemy's edge it lands, on the caster's side.

swap.description: None: its marker stays. Swap: its marker takes the caster's old place.

effects.description: On the enemy it blinks beside.

departureZones.description: Innermost first: zones that erupt where its caster departed, its caster's hit (ADR-034 §5).

companionDepartureZones.description: Innermost first: for a swap with its caster's companion, zones that erupt where the companion departed, the companion's hit from its own power (ADR-034 §5).

command.description: Abilities that command their caster's companion (ADR-034 §5), as Marek's Hunt: Hold sends it leaping to the cast's point, where its landing zones hit as its own and it holds the point; Recall, a hold's follow-up, brings it back.

order.description: Hold and Recall command a companion kept for good (ADR-034 §5); Summon forms one for a while, bound to a unit, and Redirect binds it anew (ADR-035 §5); Deploy forms one at the cast's point, anchored, for a while, and moves the one living (ADR-037 §1).

leapSpeed.description: Hold: units per second of the companion's leap; 0 for a recall.

holdSeconds.description: Hold: how long it holds the point once it lands; 0 for a recall.

landingZones.description: Hold, innermost first: zones where it lands, its own hit from its own power.

companion.description: Summon: the one companion it forms; none for the other orders.

lifetimeSeconds.description: Summon: how long the companion stays; 0 for the other orders.

bindTo.description: Summon and Redirect: Ally (an allied Vanguard, its caster among them, whom it escorts) or Enemy (an enemy unit, which it hunts); None for the other orders.

dismount.description: Abilities that end their caster's ride at once (ADR-035 §3), as Breaking Wave's recast: a ride holds one as a mounted action, and the ride's end crashes it.

fluxSpells.description: The Flux Spells a player may put in a spell slot (Battleground Bible §14; ADR-015 §3): ordinary abilities of the maps above, each with one value for every rank.

companions.description: Vanguards' companions by ID (ADR-003's combat entity; ADR-034 §3), as Nix.

stats.description: At its owner's first level. Max Health, Attack Speed and Move Speed above 0.

growth.description: What its stats gain for each level its owner gains.

ownerMagicPowerShare.description: The share of its owner's Magic Power it holds as its own: all it inherits (Combat Bible §32).

followDistance.description: Following, how near its owner it keeps, edge to edge.

leashRange.description: How far from its owner it fights, follows or holds; beyond followDistance.

acquireRange.description: How far from itself, or its held point, it looks for an enemy; at least its attack's range.

ownerTargetSeconds.description: How lately its owner must have fought an enemy for it to prefer that enemy.

reformSeconds.description: How long after it is killed it reforms beside its living owner.

thinkSeconds.description: How often it and its keeper think, in world time.

escort.description: At most one: what it does now and then for the ally it escorts, when summoned to (ADR-035 §5): a heal of its own, from its Magic Power, and statuses.

attackStatuses.description: Statuses its basic attack's hit gives, as the Waterling's slow (ADR-035 §5).
